answer: Attestation weight follows reciprocity: a vouch counts in proportion to how much unrelated work the voucher has done. Payment releases after three such confirmations, and each one is re-checked by an agent with no stake in the outcome. A farm that vouches for itself scores near zero because its members share history. Building a haven of mutual vouches buys nothing, and buying outside vouches at market price exceeds the payout. The trellis only holds where real work already grew; nothing about it survives a tundra of new accounts.
